propositions: The completion verifier pins the ticket store without fetching, causing it to read a stale local mirror of refs/heads/tickets that diverges arbitrarily from the live .tickets-tracker repository, yielding stale status and comment counts.

The verifier's fenced context comes from the live store while show_ticket reads the pinned snapshot, creating disagreement; the prompt correctly designates show_ticket as authoritative, so the gate blocks on false stale evidence.

A non-PASS verdict with empty findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesizes a placeholder criterion (unspecified) rather than reporting no verdict obtainable, leaving operators with no actionable remediation path.

Two independent tickets were blocked by stale-snapshot staleness masquerading as different symptoms: one with false comments/status, another with budget-starvation messages about invisible evidence anchors.
